book.name: MULUM PASA
book.title: MULUM PASA Kuate tuku mulum pasa Mosesŋge kuyarna

content: Yosef aba kat nuŋe wit piyawam Isip kilke mbol kinaig
Kile Yakob Isipŋge wit minnaig ta isna sulumba nuŋe kiŋo kat nuŋe saniŋgina: Ndaŋam saka tane guba tuku ri ndamba ake minig?
Isipŋge wit minig ŋga sakade le iset. Tane kumba ka afu piyawap. Kuga ta sine gubanu kumamŋgig ŋgina.
Taŋakina le Yosef tuku aba kat nuŋe 10 ta tiŋga wit piyawam tuku Isip kilke mbol kinaig ta
Yakob nu Yosef tuku mambo nuŋe ndinok Benyamin piti ande te-silikikat ŋga nane ndoŋ pilna le ndakina.
Kananŋge guba suŋgo prona tukunu Israel tuku kiŋo kat nuŋe mbal afu ndoŋ wit piyawam Isip kilke mbol pronaig.
Yosef nu Isip tuku gabat suŋgo minna tukunu nuŋge wit ŋakmba kulatka piyamba minna. Ta tuku nuŋe aba kat nuŋe nane pro nu tumailamŋge dagol tidroŋga lokinaig le

Yosef nu nuŋe aba kat nuŋe kaŋgerka katesena sulumba nu ndek nane-naneniŋmba ŋerŋerka pasa saŋgrimbi nane kusnaniŋgina: Tane aniŋge prowaig ŋgina le nane nu sanaig: Sine Kananŋge nyamagaŋ piyawam tuku te prowig ŋginaig.
Yosef nu aba kat nuŋe kateseniŋgina ta nane nu kaŋgermba wam lislisnaig le
nu o buk kiŋatina ta kile idusmba saniŋgina: Tane ma wam katesewam tuku likade. Tumbraŋ ndaŋ ndaŋ nu kame buwam tuku saŋgri kuga ta kaŋgermba likade ŋgina le
nane nu sanaig: O taŋgo suŋgo, taŋamba kuga. Sine ne tuku piro taŋgo ndo. Sine nyamagaŋ piyawam prowig.
Sine tugu ndindo ndo. Sine ma wam katesewam tuku li ndakeg. Sine yabri pasa sa ndaka son pasa sakeg ŋginaig kande
Yosef ndek nane saniŋgina: Kuga. Tane sine tuku kilke tugu te ndaŋ ndaŋ nu kame buwam tuku saŋgri kuga ta kaŋgeram prowaig ŋgina.

Taŋakina le nane ndek sakinaig: O taŋgo suŋgo, sine taŋgo ndindo tuku kutu. Mam nu Kanannu. Sine ŋakmba taŋgo 12 ta sine tuku mambo ande kumna. Siŋgine maib fudiŋ kusregeŋ le mam ndoŋ minit ŋginaig kande
Yosef ndek nane saniŋgina: Ye sakit not ndo. Tane ma wam katesewam tuku likade.
Ye katesewam tuku tane teŋenmba tagotiŋgamŋgit. Ye sonndo Farao tuku nyu mbolŋge pasa saŋgri pilewet. Tane tuku maib taŋgine te nda prowa ta tane ŋakmba maŋ luka taŋgine tumbraŋ kine nda.

Tane tuku ande luka kumba ka maib taŋgine tumba te prowa. Tane afu ŋakmba muli wande kape le tane son sakade e ko yabrikade ta ye kaŋgeramŋgit. Ye siŋka Farao tuku nyu mbolŋge saket. Maib taŋgine nda prowa ta ye kila tane ma wam katesewam tuku likade ŋgina.
Nu taŋamba sake deŋpurmba nane kilmba muli wandek sinamŋge patikina le ait keŋmba minnaig.
Ait keŋnu mbolŋge Yosef ndek nane saniŋgina: Ye Kuate kumnemŋge minmba nu tuku nyu kurauket tuku. Tane ye tuku miŋge dubiwap ta tane maye minamŋgaig.
Tane son pasa sakade ndeta tane tuku ande muli wandek sinam teŋge minwa le tane afu ŋakmba taŋgine wit piyanaig ta kilmba ka taŋgine kuasmbi gubak tawondo minig ta niŋgap.
Taŋamba taŋgine maib taŋgine fudiŋ ta tumba ye tugum prowap. Taŋawap le ye tane son sakade ta kaŋgermba ye tane baletiŋge nda ŋgina.

Taŋakina le Yosef aba kat nuŋe naŋgine naŋgine teŋenmba sakinaig: Son. Sine siŋgine miroŋ siŋgine maib tumba ŋayo siligeŋ le nu wamdus fagka sarsarka ye turyap e ŋgina ta sine ismba nda isanu sukgeŋ. Wam ta tuku kile sine piti teg ŋginaig.
Taŋakinaig le Ruben ndek sakina: Ye o buk satiŋgen: Siŋgine maib ŋayo sili ndawap ŋgen ta tane ye tuku pasa nda isnaig. Kile ndare ta lafunu piti teg ŋgina.

Yosef nu nane tuku pasa ta kagmaŋga minna ta aba kat nuŋe nane katese ndanaig. Ta ndaŋam? Yosef nu nane ndoŋ Hibru pasa ndatina. Nane pasatanu le pasa mbilam taŋgo andeŋge pasa mbilmba Yosef aba kat nuŋe saniŋganu.
Kile Yosef nu nane kusreka ka malmbikina. Nu malmbi deŋpurmba maŋ pro nane ndoŋ pasatumba minna sulumba Simeon madimba aba kat nuŋe tumailamŋge ndaleka kusnaig.
Yosef aba kat nuŋe luka Kanan kinaig

Kile Yosef ndek nane afu wam pagukina le nu tuku pasa dubimba aba kat nuŋe tuku bek ta wit fuluknye likinaig sulumba nane tuku ndametiŋ mata luka wit bek sinam taŋge sigrikinaig. Taŋanaig sulumba nyamagaŋ afu ndinŋge nyam tuku turmba niŋginaig.
Taŋanaig le aba kat nuŋe nane wit piyanaig ta kilmba naŋgine doŋki kame mbolŋge patikinaig sulumba kinaig kumba ka
furirna le kinyanu ma ande mbol promba nane tuku ande nuŋe doŋki tuku nyamagaŋ kilam saka nuŋe bek talka mambilna kande nuŋe ndametiŋ bek sinam taŋge minnaig le kaŋgerkina.

Kaŋgerkina sulumba aba kat nuŋe wika saniŋgina: Ai te. Ye tuku ndametiŋ luka sigrikaig te ŋgina. Taŋakina le nane wamdus fulilka kuru-kuruka naŋgine naŋgine sakinaig: i ... Kuate nu ame maŋau sine mbolŋge teŋenmba kat ŋginaig.
Nane ndek kumba ka Kanan kilke mbol promba mam naŋgine tugum kinaig sulumba wam ŋakmba ta nu kubeu tumba sakinaig:
Isip tuku gabat suŋgo ta ŋerŋerka pasa saŋgrimbi sine ndoŋ pasatina sulumba tane ma wam katesewam tuku likade ŋgina le
sine lafumba sakigeŋ: Sine ma katesewam tuku mbal kuga. Sine son pasa ndo sakeg.
Sine taŋgo ndindo tuku kutu. Sine ŋakmba taŋgo 12 ta mambo ande kumna le sine tuku maib fudiŋ kile mam ndoŋ Kananŋge minit ŋga sageŋ le
taŋgo ta nu sakina: Tane son sakade e ko kuga ta ye kaŋgeramŋgit. Tane ande ye ndoŋ minwa le tane afu ŋakmba wit kilmba ka taŋgine kuasmbi gubak tawondo minig ta niŋgap.

Taŋamba taŋgine maib taŋgine tumba ye tugum prowap le tane ma katesewam tuku mbal kuga tane son pasa sakade ta ye kaŋgeramŋgit. Tane taŋawap le ye taŋgine aba taŋgine paska luka tane tiŋgi le tane teŋge ndo nyamagaŋ piyamba minap ŋga sasiŋgina ŋginaig.
Nane taŋamba mam naŋgine sanaig sulumba naŋgine bek wit ŋak ta kutuniŋmba naŋgine pale fat yimyam ndametiŋ ŋak ŋak ta kaŋgerka mam naŋgine ndoŋ kuru kuru suŋgo tinaig sulumba

mam naŋgine ndek saniŋgina: Tane ndaŋam saka yiŋe kiŋo kame ŋakmba kile-ŋgisikade e? Yosef buk ŋgisikina. Simeon kile maŋ ŋgisikat. Kile tane maŋ Benyamin tumba kambim tuku sakade. Ye sonndo piti suŋgomba kile-sigliket ŋgina.

Taŋakina le Ruben ndek mam nuŋe sana: O mam, ne isa. Ye Benyamin nda tumba ne tugum luka prowi ndeta ne yiŋe kiŋo ar ta bale fara. Sine kumba yeŋge Benyamin kulatki sulumba maŋ luka ne tugum prowamŋgit ŋgina le

Yakob nu sana: Yiŋe kiŋo ta tane ndoŋ kine nda. Aba nuŋe buk kumna. Kile nu nuŋe ndo minit. Nu mata ndinŋge piti ande te-silikikat. Ye buk saibo pilen. Nu kumwa ta tane ye tuku ŋgamuŋgal kuerkap le ye wamdus tatrukuwa le kumamŋgit ŋgina.
